name: EAGLES
aliases: Efficient Accelerated 3D Gaussians with Lightweight EncodingS
definition: A method that quantizes all Gaussian attributes including color, position, opacity, rotation, and scaling.
summary: EAGLES optimizes 3D Gaussian Splatting by compressing attributes into latent vectors decoded by an MLP, reducing memory and training time while distinguishing itself from hierarchical methods through attribute-level compression.
